screening_decisions.reason: Double-blind controlled trial of aminophylline versus placebo in acute ischemic stroke; intervention initiated during the acute hospitalization. Meets randomized acute-treatment criteria for eligible drug and comparator.
Double-blind controlled trial of intravenous aminophylline versus placebo in acute cerebral infarction with acute administration; aligns with randomized acute-treatment criteria.
Open-label, single-arm dose-escalation safety study without randomization or control group; does not meet randomized controlled trial criterion.
Physiological study across mixed agents (vincamine, aminophylline) on cerebral metabolism; not a randomized acute ischemic stroke trial versus placebo/control.
Randomized cross-over physiological study in patients recovering from stroke (not within 1 week of onset) with cerebral blood flow endpoints; not an acute-treatment RCT versus placebo/control.
Randomized cross-over physiological study in recovering stroke patients with cerebral blood flow endpoints; outside acute window and not a parallel-group acute-treatment RCT.
Small physiological infusion study of aminophylline on cerebral blood flow; not a randomized controlled acute ischemic stroke treatment trial.
Animal experiment (cats) assessing vascular responses; preclinical and not a randomized clinical trial in acute stroke patients.
Animal study (dogs) of cardiovascular effects; not a clinical randomized acute ischemic stroke trial.
Mechanistic/observational discussion of aminophylline in cerebral vascular conditions; lacks randomized acute ischemic stroke trial design with placebo/control.
